Establish one complete freestanding climbing support frame in a wide landscape scene. A single horizontal gray overhead beam has two complete ends, each physically joined to the top of its own continuous vertical post. Each post runs uninterrupted down to a whole rigid grounded base with coherent braces and real floor contact. Both complete bases, both entire posts and every beam-to-post connection are visible together inside the frame. Leave empty white around the whole apparatus, broad clear floor beneath the central rope and enough air between the person's hands and the beam for a short future climbing reach. The complete figure is modest and lower within this full structural scene, rather than filling the canvas.

One continuous plain gray rope is attached at the beam center through a readable closed loop/shackle connection. It hangs down beside one quietly braced anatomical adult through two real hand grips and a readable foot lock, with one free tail continuing to the floor. Use a distant elevated rear-side three-quarter camera that exposes both closed hands, their fingers/thumbs/wrists, the lateral back and both separate ordinary feet. One hand grips the rope above the other near the head. With knees bent, one ordinary foot hooks the rope under its arch and the other presses the rope against that foot, visibly sharing the body's support with the hands. The rope enters and exits this clamp without piercing either sole. The body rests only a short distance above the clear landing floor; no climb or descent is underway.

Render an adult with attached fine silver-gray skeletal muscle fibers on all exposed surfaces and fully opaque charcoal shorts. Only the real lateral latissimus fiber fans from the lower thoracic/lumbar region toward the upper-arm insertion are bounded orange. The spine, central back, shoulder caps, biceps, forearms, thighs and calves remain gray. Ordinary fingers/bare feet and the whole scalp remain complete. The scene contains only this complete adult, one connected rope, the physically continuous grounded support frame and seamless white floor/background, with natural contact shadows. No text, rating label, inset, extra implement or display stand is present; no certification of hardware strength is claimed.
